notes: DIRECTOR, READ THIS. (1) The film's turn must be built as two separate facts, never one. Reuters says H and P supplies Exxon's automated rig. H and P says a robotic rig for an unnamed customer beat its own crews' average. Do not fuse them into 'Exxon's robot beat the humans'. (2) The P50 definition survived verbatim and is the strongest line in the package. Use c13 exactly. (3) 25 percent of large firms is 2 of 8 firms. Do not narrate it as a trend, and prefer the 62 percent all-firms figure. (4) The c18 quote as published carries an en dash in its date range. House rules ban dashes, so it is written here with the word range spelled as a hyphen and it must never be put on screen as a super. Speak the date as December 3rd to 11th if it is spoken at all. (5) The Red Zone sign text contains a colon. It is signage inside a quote, so it stands, but do not let a colon leak into narration. (6) The employment claims exist to PREVENT a false causal beat, not to supply one. If the script can not carry c24's 'still up for the year' alongside c22, drop both. (7) All word-numbers in c8 (two miles, six days, third fastest) are spelled out in the source and carry no digit tokens, so they pass as words but no digit form of them is authorised.
